long_description:
Overview

A causal meet-up and networking event for professionals working in the perinatal space in greater Wellington.

Join the Wellington Perinatal Network.




Our final hui for 2026! Come and join us for a celebratory-style catch up to end the year at the Pātaka Art + Museum in Porirua.

And as a little something extra special, our network member Maddie from Milestone Photography is going to bring along her camera and set up a little Christmas-inspired corner so we can grab some lovely seasonal pics! Thank you Maddie!

.............................................................................................................................................................................

Do you work with or offer services to whānau who are pregnant or postpartum? Would you like to learn more about the variety of support available for your clients in their community, plus expand your professional network too?

You are invited to join the Wellington Perinatal Network. An informal, professional network of practitioners working with folks who are having, who have had, or are in the thick of raising pēpi and tamariki.

Whatever you offer - whether birth preparation/education, lactation consultancy, pelvic physio, chiropractic, massage therapy, doula services, infant massage courses or mental health services (plus the many other talented and valued perinatal offerings in our community) - come along and share your knowledge and passion with a view to increased collaboration in this space.

Each event features a couple of short introductory talks from practitioners based in the Wellington region, plus the chance to introduce yourself and your mahi, plus share ideas and experiences with other like-minded practitioners.

Unwind, reconnect and build lasting relationships with Wellington’s building services community over drinks and platters.

Join CIBSE & AHSCA Wellington for a festive evening of connection, conversation, and celebration as we wind down after another big year in the building services industry! Everyone is welcome, whether you're a member, industry professional, or simply interested in connecting with the building services community.

Whether you're catching up with familiar faces or meeting new people, this is the perfect opportunity to unwind, mingle, share experiences, and strengthen connections across our industry community.

Interested in getting more involved? Membership with CIBSE offers access to industry-specific resources, professional development, training, and networking opportunities. Hydraulic engineers are also encouraged to explore AHSCA membership and connect with fellow professionals in the hydraulic industry.

Come along, celebrate the year with us, and enjoy a relaxed evening of great company and networking. We look forward to seeing you there!

The mission of CIBSE in Australia and New Zealand is to provide our members and the greater building industry with progressive leadership, knowledge, and promote competence that forges new standards of excellence in design, science and engineering of the built environment.

Our vision is to be the predominant Professional Association for building services engineers in Australia and New Zealand.

www.cibse.org.au

CIBSE Privacy Policy

The Chartered Institution of Building Services Engineers (CIBSE) is committed to protecting your privacy, and takes its responsibilities regarding the security of members' and customers' information very seriously. For the purpose of registering you for this event and providing you with further information in relation to this event we will process your personal data within our customer database. On the basis of legitimate interest we may use your data to inform you of similar events in the future and to promote services, activities and commercial objectives that are designed to support the science, art and practice of building services engineering . For more information about how we process any personal information that we collect about you, how you can instruct us if you prefer to limit the use of that information and procedures that we have in place to safeguard your privacy please view our privacy policy




Event Behavioural Policy

CIBSE wants all attendees to feel welcome and included at our events. We ask attendees to keep in mind that they are within a professional environment when at CIBSE events and they are expected to always demonstrate professional behaviour modelling high standards of ethical conduct, honesty and integrity to protect the reputation and standing of CIBSE. CIBSE will not tolerate or allow any discriminatory or disrespectful behaviours by any person during CIBSE events, including bullying, harassment or sexist, racist, or exclusionary comments or jokes at our events. Where alcohol is provided, attendees are expected to know their limits and drink responsibly. The provision of alcohol should not be taken as an endorsement by CIBSE for attendees to drink excessively nor for any resulting improper conduct or activity.

By registering for this event, you agree to abide by the CIBSE Event Behavioural Policy.




Event Photography

By attending this event, you acknowledge that you may be photographed or filmed. These images may be used to promote the organisation's work and future events. If you do not wish for your image to be taken, please notify the event staff immediately upon arrival at the event.

Wellington, Wellington-Event Brite
name: Soul Shuffle-A Shuffle Workshop
long_description:
Overview

Find your groove. Feel the music. Move your way.

SOUL SHUFFLE WITH RENEE MACDONALD 💃🎶
Please try to arrive by 545pm so we can get everyone into the event and start on time at 6pm.




Find your groove. Feel the music. Move your way.




I’m Renee MacDonald, a lifelong shuffler, DJ and music promoter based in Pōneke, Wellington.




I’ve been shuffling since my early 20s, first learning in Melbourne, where the shuffle movement emerged in the early 2000s. Now, at 48, my passion for dance and music is stronger than ever. Over the years, I’ve continued to refine my own style and develop my signature groove.




As a DJ and promoter, music has always been a huge part of my world. Soul Shuffle brings together my love of music, movement, connection and self-expression.




So, what is Soul Shuffle?




Soul Shuffle isn’t about perfecting complicated dance moves or trying to look like someone else. It’s about learning to connect with the music and finding your own way to move.

You’ll start by learning the basic foundations and footwork of shuffling. We’ll build on those steps, develop muscle memory and explore how to move your feet differently while finding your rhythm.




It’s about building confidence, discovering your flow and letting the music guide you.

You don’t need previous dance experience. You just need a willingness to give it a go!

And remember, age is just a number. Whether you’re in your 20s, 40s, 50s or beyond, there’s no age limit on dancing.

Soul Shuffle is about how you groove, not how many moves you know.

End the session on a high note with a delicious plant-based dinner and dessert.

long_description:
Overview

Come join us for a fun-filled day of sewing and socializing at Karori Arts & Crafts!

Come join us for a fun-filled day of sewing and socializing at Karori Arts & Crafts! Whether you're a seasoned pro or just starting out, this event is perfect for anyone who loves to sew. Bring your latest project or start something new - either way, you'll have a blast chatting with fellow sewing enthusiasts. Bring your current project or get inspired by others' creations at our friendly gathering. Share tips, tricks, and stories while working on our projects together.

Don't forget to pack your sewing machine, fabric, and any other supplies you'll need. We can't wait to see what you create! You will need to bring your own machine and materials. Please bring an extension lead and multipoint box if you have one. (Don't worry, though—we have some in the centre, too!) We'll supply an iron and ironing board to share, as well as a table and relatively comfy chair each. There are also spare cutting-out tables at a taller height. You are welcome to come along and work on hand-sewing projects.

A kitchen is available on site and supermarkets as well as cafes are very close by.Parking is free and there are 3 dedicated spaces for the centre as well as others closeby.

Cost: Free for members of the Karori Arts Centre or $15 per person payable directly to KACC. (Membership of the centre is $115 annually and also gives you reductions on classes and access to other groups)

Please do NOT attend if you are sick (even just a little bit!)
